parameters.query:
WITH proy AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.nombre, p.activo, c.nombre AS cliente,
         GREATEST(
           similarity(unaccent(lower(p.nombre)), unaccent(lower($1::text))),
           COALESCE(MAX(similarity(unaccent(lower(pa.alias)), unaccent(lower($1::text)))), 0)
         ) AS score
  FROM proyectos p
  JOIN clientes c ON c.id = p.cliente_id
  LEFT JOIN proyecto_alias pa ON pa.proyecto_id = p.id
  WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL AND $1::text <> ''
  GROUP BY p.id, p.nombre, p.activo, c.nombre
),
cli AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.nombre,
         similarity(unaccent(lower(c.nombre)), unaccent(lower($2::text))) AS score
  FROM clientes c
  WHERE $2::text IS NOT NULL AND $2::text <> ''
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'nombre', nombre, 'activo', activo, 'cliente', cliente, 'score', score) ORDER BY score DESC)
    FROM (SELECT * FROM proy WHERE score >= 0.25 ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 3) x
  ), '[]'::json) AS proyecto_candidatos,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'nombre', nombre, 'score', score) ORDER BY score DESC)
    FROM (SELECT * FROM cli WHERE score >= 0.25 ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 3) x
  ), '[]'::json) AS cliente_candidatos,
  $3::jsonb AS operacion;

INSERT INTO admin_pending (usuario_id, accion, paso, entidad_id, payload)
VALUES ($1, 'modo', $2, $3, $4::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (usuario_id) DO UPDATE
SET accion = 'modo', paso = EXCLUDED.paso, entidad_id = EXCLUDED.entidad_id,
    payload = EXCLUDED.payload, actualizado_en = now()
RETURNING id;
